en.title: Taylor Swift and Jaafar Jackson Lead 2026 HMMA Winners
en.summary: The Hollywood Music in Media Awards have revealed their 2026 honorees, celebrating outstanding contributions to film and television music. This year's ceremony recognized a diverse range of talent, from pop superstar Taylor Swift to rising actor Jaafar Jackson.
en.body:
The 2026 Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA) have rolled out their list of winners, spotlighting the year's most impactful music in film and television. Among the notable recipients are global phenomenon **Taylor Swift** and **Jaafar Jackson**, who is making waves with his portrayal of his iconic uncle.

**Taylor Swift** and **Jack Antonoff** took home an award for their animated song “I Knew It, I Knew You,” featured in a project that has not yet been fully detailed beyond its animated song category. Swift's continued success in the music and entertainment industry is undeniable, with this award adding another accolade to her already impressive 2026, which saw her win eight awards at the Billboard Music Awards, including top artist. Her ventures into directing her first feature film for Disney also signal a significant expansion of her creative endeavors beyond music.

Meanwhile, **Jaafar Jackson** earned recognition for his powerful performance of “Bad” from the highly anticipated biopic **Michael**. Jackson, son of Jermaine Jackson, embodies his uncle, the King of Pop, in a role that has generated considerable buzz. The film **Michael** is set to explore the life and career of the legendary entertainer, and Jackson's performance has already resonated with award bodies.

## A Celebration of Cinematic Soundtracks

The HMMA also honored achievements in score composition and other song categories. The film **The Odyssey**, directed by **Travis Scott** and starring **Matt Damon**, **Tom Holland**, **Zendaya**, and **Anne Hathaway**, also saw a nomination for its track "When I'm Home." This recognition underscores the vital role music plays in storytelling, enhancing narratives and creating memorable cinematic experiences. The awards celebrate not just the artists but the collaborative effort behind bringing music to the screen, from songwriting and performance to score composition and soundtrack curation. The sheer diversity of nominated works, spanning animated features to dramatic biopics, reflects the rich tapestry of music's influence across all genres of visual media.

## Fan Buzz and Anticipation

Fans are buzzing with excitement over the HMMA winners, particularly the recognition for **Jaafar Jackson**'s transformative role in **Michael**. The biopic is one of the most anticipated releases of the year, and Jackson's ability to capture the essence of **Michael Jackson** is a key talking point. Similarly, **Taylor Swift**'s continued success, especially with her foray into directing and her songwriting prowess, keeps her fanbase engaged and eager for her next projects. The awards serve as a powerful indicator of what audiences can expect to be discussing and celebrating in the world of film and music in the coming months, fueling anticipation for the nominated films and the artists behind their soundtracks.

## What's Next

With the HMMA winners announced, attention now turns to the upcoming film releases and potential award season contenders. Further details regarding the release of **Michael** and the full soundtrack for **The Odyssey** are expected soon, promising more opportunities to experience the music that has captivated critics and audiences alike.
